**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2**

Section 2.2 makes Copperleaf our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term." That is full-term exclusive dealing with no category narrowing, no 12-month cap, and no performance-based exit — walk-away territory under the EXCLUSIVITY rule, not merely short of preferred. It also conflicts with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: Section 2.2 becomes a non-exclusive appointment with an express right for us to procure equivalent services from third parties; Section 12.3 is preserved as-is.
